nphi.title: QUANTUM – quality and utility labels for health data (EHDS)
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Instituto Aragonés de Ciencias de la Salud (coordinator); 35 partner organisations
nphi.summary: Project developing quality and utility labels for health data for the European Health Data Space, with 35 organisations across 14 countries including Norway.

nphi.title: UNITED4Surveillance – Union and National Capacity Building for Integrated Surveillance
nphi.actor: RIVM
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (WP lead); Robert Koch Institute; Statens Serum Institut; THL; AGES; NVSC Lithuania; SZÚ Czechia; ECDC; Ukraine (observer country)
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action of ~40 public health institutes from 24 countries, coordinated by RIVM, to strengthen integrated infectious disease surveillance (outbreak detection, hospital surveillance, One Health); Norway's NIPH co-leads work…

nphi.title: 2023 IANPHI Europe Annual Meeting (Lisbon)
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Dr. Ricardo Jorge (INSA)
nphi.with: FHI; IPH Montenegro; THL; NIJZ Slovenia; RIVM; Public Health Wales; Sciensano; TAI Estonia; GÖG; EODY; PHC Ukraine; BZgA; UKHSA; Santé publique France; ECDC; WHO Europe; EuroHealthNet
nphi.summary: INSA hosted European NPHIs to discuss new challenges for the next decade, including climate and environment, health security and health data.

nphi.title: UNITED4Surveillance – integrated surveillance of infectious diseases
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: RIVM (coordinator/supporting organisation); NIPH Norway; partners in about 22-25 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action led by RIVM with over 40 partners, including Norway, building integrated and coordinated surveillance of infectious threats.

nphi.title: JADE Health – Joint Action addressing Dementia and Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action on dementia with 17 countries including Norway and Ukraine; Slovenian pilot on awareness and stigma reduction.

nphi.title: TEHDAS2 – Towards the European Health Data Space
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.summary: Second Joint Action on the European Health Data Space across 29 countries including Norway and Iceland; NIJZ contributes to two work packages.

nphi.title: ODIN – Strengthening environmental surveillance to advance public health action
nphi.actor: Lund University
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL); Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Ghent University; VIB; University of Oxford; NORCE
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project piloting genomic wastewater and environmental surveillance of pathogens and AMR genes in Burkina Faso, DRC and Tanzania, with Finland's THL and Tanzania's NIMR as partners.

nphi.title: EU-WISH – EU Wastewater Integrated Surveillance for Public Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health; Statens Serum Institut (supporting organisation); partners from 26 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action with partners in 26 countries (incl. non-EU Norway and Ukraine) to strengthen wastewater-based surveillance of biological and chemical agents.

nphi.title: ODIN-Mpox – Wastewater and environmental surveillance for mpox in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.actor: Lund University
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Université de Kinshasa (scientific lead); University of Helsinki; Ghent University; VIB; CNRST-IRSS; University of Oxford; NORCE
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project applying genomic wastewater and environmental surveillance to track mpox in the DRC and neighbouring countries, with Tanzania's NIMR as a beneficiary.

nphi.title: EU Twinning: Strengthening the capacity of Serbia's health sector for communicable disease surveillance
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'; Ministry of Health of Serbia
nphi.summary: A €1 million EU twinning in which THL helped harmonise laboratory capacity, training, IT and data flows across Serbia's public health institute network.

nphi.title: EU Twinning: Support in implementation of Health Impact Assessment practice in Georgia
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC) Georgia; Expertise France (lead Member State partner)
nphi.summary: Built NCDC Georgia's capacity to integrate health into impact assessment and align environmental health law with the EU Association Agreement.

nphi.title: SHARP JA – Strengthened International Health Regulations and Preparedness
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Public Health Wales (UK partner); THL (coordinator); RIVM; NIJZ; AGES; Switzerland took part as a collaborating partner with its own funding
nphi.summary: A joint action to help countries implement the International Health Regulations and strengthen preparedness for serious cross-border health threats, including laboratory capacity and chemical threats.

nphi.title: Support to Ukraine for Developing a Modern Public Health System
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; Ministry of Health of Ukraine; GFA Consulting Group (co-implementer)
nphi.summary: EU-funded project (€5.8m) co-implemented by THL. It strengthened the Ukrainian Public Health Centre, aligned surveillance and response legislation with the EU, reformed blood safety and trained more than 1,500 professionals.

nphi.title: ARIVAC – Evaluation of pneumococcal and Hib conjugate vaccines against childhood pneumonia in South-East Asia
nphi.actor: National Public Health Institute (KTL)
nphi.with: Research Institute for Tropical Medicine (RITM, Philippines); First Pediatric Hospital of Ho Chi Minh City; University of Copenhagen; Pasteur Mérieux Sérums et Vaccins
nphi.summary: EU-funded study coordinated by Finland's National Public Health Institute (KTL, now THL) evaluating conjugate vaccines to prevent childhood pneumonia in the Philippines and Vietnam.

nphi.title: THL–NIMR Tanzania partnership on NCD surveillance
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania
nphi.summary: Under an IANPHI comprehensive project running since 2007, Finland's THL partnered with Tanzania's NIMR to strengthen surveillance and prevention of non-communicable diseases. This included an IANPHI-supported NCD workshop in 2011.
